sottotitolo: Workouts left open, overlapping, closed automatically, too long or without sets: they skew the statistics. Correct them, merge them or mark them as checked. The user gets a notification.
selezionati_one: {count} workout selected: choose at least another one of the same user
selezionati_other: {count} workouts selected: they will become a single free workout
utentiDiversi: Only workouts of the same user can be merged
confermaUnisci_other: Merge {count} workouts into a single free workout, with all the sets?
confermaElimina: Delete this workout with all its sets? The user will get a notification.
